mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand for housing and economic expansion, which is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity and supply, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential deflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and the number of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) is decreasing, it signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is decreasing and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates reduced consumer spending, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) above 3% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, which is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.
